sections.h2: Rate gap: 25 economies sit below India's repo rate, about 13 are reachable

chart.title: The 13 reachable currencies show gaps from 0.90 to 5.50 points against India
chart.sub: Policy-rate gap against India's 5.50% repo, percentage points, 26 October 2026; economies marked as an issuance currency for an Indian PSU or NBFC.
chart.source: Central bank releases; BIS policy rate statistics.

sections.means: Covered interest parity means the hedge costs about what the cheap coupon saves, which is why hedged yen landed below 7% rather than near 3%.
sections.todo: Harvest the gap only where an issuer can leave part of it unhedged against matching foreign-currency cash flows, or where hedging is subsidised or partly waived.

sections.h2: Rupee over 10 years: -42.4% vs dollar, -44.7% vs euro, +7.0% vs yen

chart.title: Ten years: rupee down 42.4% vs dollar, down 44.7% vs euro, up 7.0% vs yen
chart.sub: Rupee change against the borrowed currency, %, July 2016 to October 2026; negative means the rupee weakened.
chart.source: RBI Reference Rate Archive; yfinance monthly closes.

sections.means: An unhedged dollar or euro borrower repaid more rupees every year on the principal alone, while a yen borrower over the past decade repaid roughly the same or fewer.
sections.todo: Choose the currency for the investor base and the hedge economics, and treat any unhedged FX gain as luck, not strategy.

sections.h2: Sovereign greenium: 6bp in April 2026 after the RBI rejected every bid in June 2025

chart.title: The sovereign green label stopped paying in 2024-25 and paid again in 2026
events: India's sovereign debut priced 5-6bp inside conventional G-secs
The RBI rejected every bid at a 30-year green auction
The 7.50% GOI SGrB 2056 sold at a 6bp greenium, the largest since January 2023
Reopened with ₹5,000 crore notified for 14 August; greenium reported at about 4bp, not checked against the RBI result
Reopened again with ₹3,000 crore notified for 1 October

sections.means: The sovereign programme now shows that the label pays when supply is kept short, with ₹15,000 crore of 30-year green tranches of ₹3,000 crore in the October 2026 to March 2027 calendar.
sections.todo: When the label stops paying, the correct response is issuance discipline rather than label inflation.

sections.h2: Rating gap: Japan is 3 notches above India on Fitch's scale, Switzerland 7

chart.title: Japan and China are 3 notches above India; the six AAA economies are 7 above
chart.sub: Notches above India on Fitch's 21-notch long-term scale, illustrative.
chart.source: S&P Global, Moody's and Fitch sovereign rating pages, August 2026.

sections.means: The economies with the cheapest funding are rated well above India, so their institutional investors have room to hold BBB- rated foreign paper.
sections.todo: A single-notch downgrade at Fitch or Moody's would push REC, PFC and EXIM out of many minimum-rating mandates, so debt trajectory is the metric to watch.
